title: Experts disagree on Eliyce/paqad-plugin references
context:
Chief architect: D-b is final as written: drop every Eliyce/paqad-plugin reference, with a grep test so the name cannot come back. The application-architect claim adds an exception for past CHANGELOG.md entries that D-b does not make. Keeping old release notes as history is only right if the owner says so in this packet.

Target: Eliyce/paqad-plugin references
- integration-architect: after the switch no file in the repo names Eliyce/paqad-plugin and the repo-root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json is gone; a source test greps for the old name so it cannot creep back
- solution-architect: D-b rename is a cross-cutting consumer change (managed settings, settings writer, release.yml, assemble script, README, tests); a repo-wide grep returning zero old references is the acceptance check
- application-architect: every tracked reference (README, release.yml, scripts/test-plugin.mjs, scripts/validate-plugin.mjs, docs/modules/onboarded-project-overview.md, tests) moves to Eliyce/paqad-claude-plugin, while past CHANGELOG.md entries stay as written history
